description: Fix CI/CD workflow issues (PR Labeler and CI tests mentioned as failing). Review and fix all GitHub Actions workflows for reliability.
steps: 1. Review .github/workflows/label.yml for potential issues - check permissions, token usage, and labeler action version compatibility
2. Review .github/workflows/ci.yml - verify concurrency groups, matrix strategy, coverage upload, all steps work correctly
3. Review .github/workflows/npm-publish.yml - verify OIDC trusted publishing is correctly configured
4. Review .github/workflows/release.yml - verify it doesn't duplicate npm publish (should trigger npm-publish.yml)
6. Review .github/labeler.yml for correct file path patterns matching repository structure
7. Add workflow_dispatch triggers where missing for manual testing
8. Add workflow badges to README.md if missing (check current badges)
9. Ensure all workflows use persist-credentials: false for security
10. Test workflows by pushing to a test branch or using workflow_dispatch
acceptance_criteria: All workflow files pass YAML lint validation
CI workflow runs successfully on push and PR
PR Labeler workflow correctly labels new PRs
npm-publish workflow is ready for release
All workflows follow security best practices (persist-credentials: false)
verification: Push a test commit and verify CI workflow runs
Create a test PR and verify labeler adds labels
Check GitHub Actions tab for workflow run history

issues_fixed: release.yml had duplicate npm publish job using NPM_TOKEN secret - removed and replaced with release-success summary job (npm-publish.yml handles publishing via OIDC)
Missing workflow_dispatch triggers in ci.yml and label.yml - added for manual testing
label.yml missing fetch-depth: 0 which could cause issues with file change detection
security_best_practices: OIDC trusted publishing for npm (no NPM_TOKEN secret needed)
